Name: AfkPool
Author: Saodm262
Description:
[size=4][b]Description

Build an AFK pool on your farm. Stand still in the water to earn passive gold while soaking in a relaxing bath animation.

The pool is a ground-level 4x2 structure with no collision — you can walk right onto it. Once you step on, your character automatically switches to the spa bathing animation. Stand still for a configurable amount of in-game time (default 10 minutes), and the pool starts paying you gold every second. A HUD overlay in the top-left corner shows a countdown timer and your accumulated earnings. Move or step off the pool and the gold stops immediately.

The pool has 3 upgrade tiers, built and upgraded at Robin's Carpenter Shop:

- Tier 1 (AFK Pool): 5g/s. Materials: 5 Iridium Bar + 500 Wood
- Tier 2 (Advanced AFK Pool): 50g/s. Materials: 10 Iridium Bar + 20 Seaweed
- Tier 3 (Ultimate AFK Pool): 500g/s. Materials: 20 Iridium Bar + 5 River Jelly + 5 Sea Jelly + 5 Cave Jelly

No gold cost — materials only. Construction and upgrades take 1 day. Upgrading replaces the pool in-place without disturbing the water tiles underneath.

The water surface is not a custom texture. The mod dynamically reads the actual water tile index from your farm's outdoor tilesheet and paints it onto the ground where the pool sits. This means the pool water matches your farm's existing rivers and ponds perfectly, across vanilla, SVE, Grandpa's Farm, Frontier Farm, and any other custom farm map. Tiles refresh automatically on season change, and demolishing the pool restores the original ground tiles.


Installation instructions

1. Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or later from https://smapi.io.
2. Download this mod.
3. Extract the zip into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder so that the path is Mods/AfkPool/ and the folder contains AfkPool.dll and manifest.json.
4. Launch the game via SMAPI (StardewModdingAPI.exe).

To uninstall: demolish any placed pools at Robin's first, then delete the Mods/AfkPool folder.


Main features

- Ground-level pool with no collision — walk on it freely.
- Spa bathing animation triggers automatically when you step onto the pool.
- Stand still to earn gold. Default AFK activation time is 10 in-game minutes (configurable via GMCM).
- 3 upgradeable tiers: 5g/s, 50g/s, 500g/s.
- HUD overlay in the top-left corner showing countdown timer and real-time gold earnings.
- Water surface uses real in-game water tiles sampled from your farm's tilesheet — matches any farm map.
- Season-aware: water tiles refresh when the season changes.
- Demolish-safe: original ground tiles are restored when the pool is removed.
- GMCM support: adjust the AFK activation time in-game via Generic Mod Config Menu.
- Console command: afkpool_status for debugging.
- No Harmony patching — compatible with all mods.


Requirements

- SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
- Stardew Valley 1.6 or later (uses BuildingData API; not compatible with 1.5)
- Recommended: Generic Mod Config Menu (for in-game settings)
